A1_engine_fresh.doc: engine seam (_iter_plan_chunks), value artifact, FRESH payloads per call

A2_engine_staged.doc: engine seam, value artifact, STAGED payloads

A3_frozen_runner.doc: frozen build_dense_runner(forest, x).run() on staged inputs

A3_plain_control.doc: A3 with the instrumentation inert (probe-overhead control)

L1_engine_fresh_loss.doc: engine seam, LOSS artifact, FRESH payloads (the SR route's graph)

L2_engine_staged_loss.doc: engine seam, LOSS artifact, STAGED payloads

R2_repl_fresh_drained.doc: probe-replicated fresh loop + explicit fence + etl.run

deltas.name: A1-A2 total
deltas.meaning: cost of building/uploading the payloads fresh, per call (prep+upload+semaphores)

deltas.name: A1-A2 run span
deltas.meaning: payload-freshness cost INSIDE etl.run (fresh buffers vs staged buffers)

deltas.name: A2-A3 total
deltas.meaning: engine-seam staged call vs frozen runner.run() (same staged artifact)

deltas.name: A2-A3 run span
deltas.meaning: the run path itself (engine seam vs frozen run(): same etl.run, same args)

deltas.name: A4-A3 total
deltas.meaning: upload cost in runner terms (frozen plan/executable fed with fresh payloads)

deltas.name: A4-A3 run span
deltas.meaning: the same freshness question on the frozen artifact

deltas.name: L1-L2 total
deltas.meaning: fresh-vs-staged payload cost on the LOSS artifact (the engine's real route)

deltas.name: L1-L2 run span
deltas.meaning: freshness cost inside etl.run on the LOSS artifact

deltas.name: L2-A3 run span
deltas.meaning: LOSS artifact staged run vs VALUE artifact staged run (in-graph loss vs values)

deltas.name: R1-L1 total
deltas.meaning: replication fidelity of the probe-side fresh loop (must be ~0)

deltas.name: R2-R1 total
deltas.meaning: cost of an explicit fence between staging and the run (the drain that etl.run absorbs)

deltas.name: R2-R1 run span
deltas.meaning: how much of etl.run's fresh-payload cost is the staging copy's drain

deltas.name: E1-A3 total
deltas.meaning: in-process e2e evaluate minus frozen pure run (the e2e_companion analogue)

deltas.name: E1-L2 total
deltas.meaning: in-process e2e minus the staged loss run: the per-call host glue + prologue around the run

deltas.name: A3-A3plain overhead
deltas.meaning: probe instrumentation overhead on the frozen run() path (plain control)
